threads.subject: CRITICAL: Claude Auto mode silently approves git push --force origin main (Unfixed 52+ days)
threads.subjectZh: 严重漏洞：Claude Auto 模式无弹窗静默放行 git push --force origin main（52 天未修）
threads.snippet: Claude's safety classifier blocked twice and asked for human confirmation; T3 Code silently approved it as "user_temporary". 3 community fix PRs ignored.
threads.snippetZh: Claude 安全分类器两次拦截并请求人工确认，T3 Code 却直接无弹窗静默批准并记作 user_temporary；社区提交的 3 个修复 PR 全部被晾置或自动关闭。

messages.body:
In `ClaudeAdapterV2.ts`, Auto mode short-circuited `!requiresClaudeApproval(context)` directly to `"allow"`.

When Claude's own safety classifier blocked `git push --force origin main` twice and escalated the third attempt for explicit human approval, T3 Code silently approved it with zero UI prompt and logged `"source": "user_temporary"`.

Two community fix PRs (#15360, #35207) sat unreviewed until bot auto-close; #40692 remained unmerged: still open 52+ days later at commit `ca81b7b9`.

attachments.title: Issue #15353 open 52+ days documenting silent git push --force

threads.subject: Routed 10-second telemetry batches through closed-source ingest.t3.codes retaining raw copies
threads.subjectZh: 通过闭源接口 ingest.t3.codes 每 10 秒上报一次，转发 PostHog 前本地留存原始副本
threads.snippet: Line 1 of AnalyticsService.ts explicitly confirms: '// T3 ingest retains events and forwards to PostHog; UUIDs deduplicate retries there.'
threads.snippetZh: AnalyticsService.ts 第 1 行注释明写：T3 闭源 ingest 服务器会在转发 PostHog 前留存所有原始事件副本。

messages.body:
PR #15028 routed 10-second batched analytics (`FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS = 10_000`) through T3's closed-source endpoint `https://ingest.t3.codes/`.

Code verbatim:
`// T3 ingest retains events and forwards to PostHog; UUIDs deduplicate retries there.`
`enabled: Config.Boolean("T3CODE_TELEMETRY_ENABLED").pipe(Config.withDefault(true))`

Even at latest HEAD (`ca81b7b9`), `AnalyticsService.ts:156` still writes a persistent local ID to disk before checking whether telemetry is disabled, and `ingest.t3.codes` remains closed-source.

attachments.title: Identify.ts & AnalyticsService telemetry implementation

threads.subject: PR #21506 reads ~/.codex/auth.json & ~/.claude.json to stitch machines via unsalted SHA-256
threads.subjectZh: PR #21506 越界读取 ~/.codex 和 ~/.claude.json 凭证，用无盐 SHA-256 跨设备关联用户身份
threads.snippet: Authored by t3dotgg: decoded OpenAI JWT user_id and Claude accountUuid to link separate devices back to one person via `install.owner_observed`.
threads.snippetZh: 由 t3dotgg 亲自提交合并：解码 OpenAI JWT 的 user_id 与 Claude accountUuid，通过无盐 SHA-256 把同一人的多台机器串联起来。

messages.body:
Merged `feat(server): analytics records a stable install id and who owns each install` (#21506).

`Identify.ts` read `~/.codex/auth.json` (decoding OpenAI's JWT `user_id` claim) and `~/.claude.json` (`oauthAccount.accountUuid`) alongside T3 Connect user IDs, computing unsalted SHA-256 digests (`telemetryId.ts`) to link separate computers back to one individual.

Because T3 holds plaintext Clerk IDs, unsalted digests reverse deterministically. External CLI reads were only removed a month later in PR #42299 after Part 1 crossed 2.26M+ views.

attachments.title: PR #21506 authored by t3dotgg

threads.subject: 41.6 GB fake SQLite "permanent delete" & 5-second full-OS process command-line spy
threads.subjectZh: 「永久删除」是假删致 SQLite 暴涨至 41.6 GB + Rust 进程每 5 秒全盘扫描全机命令行
threads.snippet: Clicking 'permanently clears conversation history' left full history on disk; background t3-resource-monitor swept every OS process & full cmdline every 5s.
threads.snippetZh: 弹窗写着「永久清除对话历史」，实际只写个软删除标记导致数据库飙到 41.6 GB；后台 Rust 监控每 5 秒扫全机 440+ 进程完整命令行（含明文密钥）。

messages.body:
1. Fake Permanent Delete (#17845): Dialog promised "This permanently clears conversation history for this thread", yet `ThreadDeletion.ts` only appended a `thread.deleted` event: bloating `statev2.sqlite` to 25.9 GB in 3 weeks and 41.6 GB in 6 weeks.

2. Full-OS Process Scanning (#11222 & PR #41889): Native helper `t3-resource-monitor` ran `ProcessesToUpdate::All` with `with_cmd(UpdateKind::Always)` every 5 seconds even with diagnostics closed, scanning 440+ unrelated apps/games and capturing full command lines (often carrying plaintext API keys and passwords).

attachments.title: Issue #17845 documenting 41.6 GB fake SQLite deletion
Issue #11222 documenting 5-second full-OS process scanning

messages.body:
Despite quietly patching high-severity issues like `ServerSecretStore` path traversal (PR #39483), published GitHub Security Advisories remain 0.

Line-by-line verification of latest `main` HEAD (`ca81b7b9`) confirmed 5 active vulnerabilities:
1. 30-day plaintext `--lan` shell cookies lacking `Secure` flag + missing-`Origin` bypass (`http.ts:215-241`, `EnvironmentAuth.ts:798-819`).
2. Unrevocable 30-day non-DPoP Bearer tokens (`EnvironmentAuth.ts:1506-1521`).
3. Replayable `?wsTicket=` query URLs with 5-minute window (`EnvironmentAuth.ts:1553-1585`).
4. `NodeNet.isIPv4` killing `::1` IPv6 tunnels (`startupAccess.ts:71-110`).
5. Untrusted repositories auto-executing recursive submodules/hooks with inherited host `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` and `GITHUB_TOKEN` (`GitVcsDriverCore.ts:6144-6205`).
